2608.27365.title: KnockGS:interaction-Grounded Calibrationof Physical Gaussian Representations
2608.27365.paper_summary: Physics-integrated 3D Gaussian representations now allow reconstructed deformable objects to be simulated and rendered under explicit material models. Existing pipelines, however, assume that material parameters are known or manually specified, limiting their applicability when these parameters must be inferred from observed object dynamics. We propose KnockGS, an interaction-response PhysicalGS framework that estimates the elasticity and density scales of a 3D Gaussian object from its dynamics under a known applied force. Rather than treating physical simulation only as a forward process, we turn the force-induced response into a calibration signal: temporal response features are xtracted from the observed dynamics, the two material scales are estimated from those features, and the estimate is then frozen and written back into the same simulator so that it can be tested on an interaction it was never fitted to.We evaluate the framework on both parameter recovery and response-level fidelity. The estimated scales are compared against hidden ground truth, and the re-simulated object is measured against the target using 3D particle trajectories, response-curve statistics, and rendered-frame quality. Across five held-out material targets, our method recovers the scales substantially more accurately than response retrieval, global regression, or a fixed default material, and the frozen estimate remains predictive under interactions that differ in direction and in magnitude. Interaction response therefore carries enough information to calibrate material scales in physically grounded 3D Gaussian representations.Our study is a first step toward interactive PhysicalGS systems that calibrate a Gaussian asset whose rendered appearance and simulated response are consistent.
2608.27365.paper_summary_zh: 物理整合的 3D 高斯表示現在允許在明確的材料模型下模擬和渲染重建的可變形物體。然而，現有的流程假設材料參數是已知或手動指定的，這限制了當這些參數必須從觀察到的物體動態中推斷時的適用性。我們提出了 KnockGS，一個互動響應的 PhysicalGS 框架，該框架從已知施加力下的動態中估計 3D 高斯物體的彈性和密度尺度。我們不僅將物理模擬視為一個前向過程，而是將力引起的響應轉化為校準信號：從觀察到的動態中提取時間響應特徵，然後從這些特徵中估計出兩個材料尺度，最後將估計值固定並寫回同一模擬器，以便在其從未適配的互動上進行測試。我們在參數恢復和響應級別保真度上評估該框架。估計的尺度與隱藏的真實值進行比較，重新模擬的物體則使用 3D 粒子軌跡、響應曲線統計和渲染幀質量進行測量。在五個保留的材料目標中，我們的方法在尺度恢復方面的準確性顯著高於響應檢索、全局回歸或固定的默認材料，並且固定的估計在方向和大小不同的互動下仍然具有預測能力。因此，互動響應攜帶了足夠的信息來校準物理基礎的 3D 高斯表示中的材料尺度。我們的研究是朝著互動式 PhysicalGS 系統邁出的第一步，這些系統校準一個高斯資產，使其渲染外觀和模擬響應保持一致。
